title: Malmgren links his life and his knowledge at MIT to time travel

tellings.quote: I've thought about this many many times and the answer is yes. Nothing else explains when I told you to MIT professor I didn't have the slightest inhibition

plain: A former advisor to US presidents named Harold Malmgren tells a podcast host, Jesse Michels, that after thinking about it many times, he believes time travel is the answer to something in his own life. He points to the 1950s at MIT, a leading science university in Cambridge, Massachusetts, when he says he spoke to a professor with no hesitation at all about things he seemed to already know. If true, it would mean his knowledge somehow came from outside his own time.
